title: BusinessVerification
description: Identity-verification result for one prospect, produced by prompts/business-verification.md before scoring. Exists to catch company-name collisions (e.g. multiple businesses named 'Example Restoration') by cross-checking the fields discovery actually found against each other.

identity_confidence.description: How confident we are that website/GBP/phone/address all refer to the SAME physical business named in business_name.

matched_fields.description: Fields that corroborate each other, e.g. 'phone matches address listing', 'website matches GBP name'

conflicting_fields.description: Fields that disagree or couldn't be reconciled, e.g. 'website domain unrelated to business name', 'address ambiguous across 2 same-named businesses'

source_notes.description: Where each matched/conflicting field claim came from
